query:
SELECT MAX(
                CASE tier
                    WHEN 'ultra' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'pro'   THEN 1
                    ELSE              0
                END
            ) AS max_tier
            FROM entitlements
            WHERE scope_type = $1
              AND scope_id = $2
              AND scope_secondary_id = $3
              AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
